metadata.title: The spherical cap conjecture for immersed disks
metadata.abstract: We prove that every smooth immersed disk in Euclidean three-space with nonzero constant mean curvature, regular up to the boundary and mapping its boundary diffeomorphically onto a circle, is an embedded spherical cap.
metadata.comment: Lemma 3.1 has also been formalized in Lean~4 with Mathlib, supplied as LEAN Resource. Comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者主张边界微分同胚映到圆、边界正则的光滑浸入圆盘，只要非零常平均曲率，就必为嵌入球冠。
analysis.breakthrough: 将结论从嵌入先验提升到浸入圆盘，解决所述球冠猜想。
analysis.limitations: 需重点核查论证；仅引理 3.1 的 Lean 形式化不代表整篇证明均形式化。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
